verdict.rationale: Box publishes an API reference at developer.box.com/reference with the base URL, OAuth requirements, and copy-paste curl examples you can run with a developer token. The llms.txt index also lists the API reference, and there is a developer-token quickstart for a first API call. Nothing shows the reference is interactive (an in-browser try-it console), and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at common paths. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser try-it console, a discoverable OpenAPI spec for tooling, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the examples.
